title: Great for Entertaining
text: Great for Entertaining. This 2 level serving tray is great for entertaining. Especially when you have limited table space. It requires some assembly. It also is designed to be taken apart easily for storage. It's sturdy, but could definitely be sturdier. I think it would be more durable if it was not meant to be taken apart for storage. It looks great! I'm excited to use it this holiday season.

product_metadata.title: ONEMORE 2-Tier Large Serving Tray - Collapsible Food Display Stand with Rectangular Ceramic Platters - Bright White
features: Elevate Your Presentation: Impress guests with an elegant tiered serving tray that saves space on your buffet table. Perfect for displaying appetizers, desserts, or cups at indoor/outdoor celebrations or parties.
Effortless Assembly and Clean-Up: Set up and take down your collapsible tiered dessert tray with ease. The dishwasher-safe ceramic platters make cleaning a breeze.
Durable and Versatile: Made of pro-grade ceramic, these lead-free porcelain dishes are built to last. They're microwave, freezer, and oven safe to 500F, so you can use them for any occasion.

Convenient Design: The slim tiered stand with handles makes it easy to transfer your carefully prepared foods from the kitchen to the table. The attractive, easily accessible dessert stand is sure to impress your guests.
Perfect Gift: Give the gift of style and convenience with this stunning dessert tray. It's an excellent choice for Mother's Day, birthdays, anniversaries, wedding registries, or Christmas.
